verbetes.glosa_atual: transferência de propriedade; documento de hipoteca fundiária.
definicoes_originais: pl., הַקְנָאָה h. f. (קני I) giving possession, whence שְׁטָרֵי אַ' or שְׁטַר ה' an agreement by which one’s landed estate is mortgaged in the form of a sale from date, independent of the loan to be consummated afterwards, so that at a certain date the creditor can claim the property, even if sold in the meantime, by referring to the priority of his purchase; deed of transfer (v. Bloch Civil-Process, p. 54, notes 5 a. 6 a. quot. ib.).
notas_originais: B. Mets. 13 a; 14 a; 16 b. B. Bath. 172 a שטרא אקניאתא (שטרי, Ms. M. ib. a. B. Ab. Zar. 11 b Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. אקניתא בחנוני, Var. אקניתיה); [cmp. Y. ib. I, 39 c where our w. seems to be rendered כנוני].

notas_originais: Sabb. VII, 2 האוֹרֵג he who weaves on the Sabbath; a. fr.—Metaph. (cmp. טרי) to argue, conclude, spin out, deduct &c. Ruth R., Par. 2, beg. (play on or’gim II Sam.
